sourceProof.eventClockPolicy: Static main/copy/plates are strict immediately when visible. Only source-tagged pose/position/scale units relax until their individual entryEnd and during their individual geometric exitStart..cut.dur; static events never relax, and any surviving ink is strict again after exit completion. Contents active states are strict under their enumerated union; no global sourceClock relaxation.
